title: Chunk Inspector: lightweight per-chunk telemetry, trace anchors, and redact-handoff for streaming outputs
creator: Meera Patel
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight 'Chunk Inspector' layer in the serving runtime and SDKs that emits deterministic per-chunk metrics and tracing anchors while performing a redact-handoff so no PII leaks into centralized telemetry. The feature should enable engineers to correlate streamed token chunks with parent requests and downstream tool/function calls, without increasing median request CPU or adding noticeable latency for producers.

Scope:
- Instrumentation points in runtime where stream frames are emitted (chunk start, chunk end, tool-call boundary).
- Per-chunk metrics: token_count, chunk_latency_ms, bytes_sent, encoding, token_window_id, tool_call_flag.
- Deterministic trace anchors (chunk_anchor_id) that allow reassembling chunked output across partial responses and retries.
- Redact-handoff API: apply policy-level redaction before telemetry export; support PII patterns and configurable customer allowlists.
- SDK helpers for structured outputs: surface chunk metadata to users and maintain backward compatibility with older streaming clients.

Out of scope: long-term retention policy changes, full conversation-level provenance (separate project), and on-prem KMS integrations (handled by Private infra team).

Success metrics:
- >90% of streaming requests produce chunk-level telemetry in prod canary.
- p99 end-to-end latency regression for streaming requests <= +5ms.
- No telemetry exports containing raw PII for tested pattern suite.
- New chunk histograms and span anchors appear in Console for target customers in canary cohort.

Rollout plan: canary on 10% of hosted traffic -> expand to 50% -> global. Start with sampling rate 10% for full payloads and 100% for metadata; increase only after performance validation. Use feature flag runtime.chunk_inspector.

Risks and mitigation:
- Telemetry overhead: implement micro-batching of metric exports and sampling knobs.
- Redaction accuracy: run fuzz tests and real-world prompt patterns (privacy harness) before enabling full exports.
- Trace reassembly complexity: include stable anchor generation (hash(request_id, seq, model_version, salt)) documented in RFC.
tasks: Finalize RFC for chunk anchors and redact-handoff
Add runtime hooks to emit chunk metadata objects (minimal allocation path)
SDK changes: expose chunk headers and optional metadata in streaming client

Create Console dashboard and chunk-level histograms

Document compatibility behavior for legacy clients

2026-03-09 Privacy Team (review): Approved redact-handoff approach but requested an allowlist feature for customer-specified safe tokens.
2026-03-11 QA: Added privacy harness tests covering 38 PII patterns; 3 false negatives found and fed back to ruleset iteration.
